issue_context.title: [NPM Package] Crash when adding a new point in the line editor
issue_context.body:
I use the alt shortcut to add the new point, then release the alt-key without clicking. Here is a demo on the latest master commit:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17577332/185786184-dc689cd2-40c6-4408-9eb0-886549ef0c9e.mov

```
Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '0')
    at LinearElementEditor.getPointAtIndexGlobalCoordinates (VM94 linearElementEditor.ts:366:71)
    at renderLinearElementPointHighlight (VM90 renderScene.ts:164:97)
    at _renderScene (VM90 renderScene.ts:257:9)
    at renderScene (VM90 renderScene.ts:465:17)
    at App.renderScene (VM40 App.tsx:396:80)
    at App.componentDidUpdate (VM40 App.tsx:3146:14)
    at commitLayoutEffectOnFiber (react-dom.development.js:23348:30)
    at commitLayoutMountEffects_complete (react-dom.development.js:24698:11)
    at commitLayoutEffects_begin (react-dom.development.js:24684:9)
    at commitLayoutEffects (react-dom.development.js:24622:5)
```
comments: @pomdtr I am debugging #5604 Are you using Excalidraw with React 18 or 17?

review_comments: that's the easy fix. Though I'm not sure what it can break down the line sine this function is used all over the place. While we should ensure this function is type-safe, we should fix the root cause — why we're asking for a point that doesn't exist,, and maybe return `null` for such points (would break a lot of upstream code in ways that I don't know how to handle though.
I had the same thoughts. This solution is just sticking plaster.
